# @potb/opencode-plugin-noop

The simplest possible [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin: a no-op POC
that registers zero hooks and has zero observable side effects on the end
user.

It exists as a minimal scaffold to:

- Verify a plugin end-to-end (publish, install, load) without any moving
  parts.
- Serve as a fork-able starting point for real plugins.

## Install

```sh
bun add -d @potb/opencode-plugin-noop
# or
npm install --save-dev @potb/opencode-plugin-noop
```

## Use

In your project's `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["@potb/opencode-plugin-noop"]
}
```

OpenCode does **not** auto-discover plugins by package name - the explicit
`opencode.json` entry above is required.

## What it does

Nothing. It exports an async function that returns an empty `Hooks` object:

```ts
import type { Plugin } from "@opencode-ai/plugin";

const plugin: Plugin = async () => ({});

export default plugin;
```
